description: Run pre-publish SEO QA for metadata, indexability, canonical, headings, schema, links, and media. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

check_external_links.description: External-link review preference. The current workflow inspects extracted link information, not the HTTP status of every external destination; fetching the source url can still access the internet. Type: Boolean. Default: false.

expected_canonical.description: Absolute canonical URL the page should declare, used as the comparison target. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Optional; no client default.

html.description: Page HTML supplied directly for analysis; provide this, markdown or a URL and avoid secrets in markup. Type: String. Minimum: 80 characters. Maximum: 250000 characters. Optional; no client default.

keyword.description: Search keyword or phrase to analyze for this workflow. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Optional; no client default.

markdown.description: Page Markdown supplied directly for analysis; provide this, html or a URL. Type: String. Minimum: 80 characters. Maximum: 50000 characters. Optional; no client default.

page_type.description: Page format or classification for this record; select one of the accepted values. Type: String. Accepted values: "auto", "article", "blog_post", "landing_page", "product", "software", "local_business", "comparison_page", "guide", "docs". Default: "auto".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Your target brand, domain or URL used to scope this workflow; supply the entity you want assessed. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

url.description: Absolute web page URL to analyze; use an http:// or https:// URL. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Optional; no client default.

name: agentseo_content_technical_qa
title: AgentSEO Content Technical QA
